data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'n-w-d', which means 'to restore' or 'to revive'. Nawzad is a name of Arabic origin that means 'Reviver', 'Restorer', or 'Bringer of life'. The name Nawzad carries the meaning “Restorer, Reviver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawzad usually hope their child will grow to embody restorer, reviver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
